summary: Baidu filed a 6-K carrying a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return covering daily on-market repurchases of its Class A ordinary shares (HKEX: 09888) for cancellation. Three tranches were bought on Sept 7-9, 2026: 545,000 shares at HKD 91.6772, 554,150 at HKD 90.2251 and 541,200 at HKD 92.383, roughly 0.025% of issued shares each and about 1.64 million shares total. Issued shares and treasury remain 2,209,541,178; repurchased shares await cancellation. The board authorized the buybacks; no advisor, price premium or termination fee disclosed. Watch pace, cancellation timing and any expanded mandate.
